passport-account.what_it_is: Passport York is York University's institutional account and sign-in service. It establishes the identity used to access eligible University systems and manages account credentials and lifecycle
passport-account.who_uses_it: Current students, faculty, staff and other approved account holders, with access determined by their affiliation
passport-account.access_note: Use Manage My Services for available account operations. Eligibility and recovery methods differ for students, employees and privileged users

sponsored-accounts.what_it_is: Sponsored accounts allow York to grant time-limited computing access to approved people who do not qualify for an ordinary student or employee account
sponsored-accounts.who_uses_it: Authorized sponsors request access for eligible guests, visiting researchers, affiliates and other approved collaborators
use_cases: Identify the sponsoring unit and period of access
Enable only the resources approved for the guest
sponsored-accounts.access_note: A York sponsor must authorize the request. Guest Wi-Fi and sponsored computing accounts are different services

1password-vault.what_it_is: 1Password is York's password manager for storing and generating unique credentials. Business, student and personal Families memberships are different offerings
1password-vault.who_uses_it: Eligible students and employees through their applicable York licence; personal Families use is separate from an institutional vault
use_cases: Share credentials using approved team vaults
1password-vault.access_note: Activate the account through York's instructions before signing in. 1Password is not Passport York

duo-authentication.what_it_is: Duo is the verification service York uses to add a second security factor after a password is entered
duo-authentication.who_uses_it: York account holders subject to multifactor authentication requirements, including students and employees
use_cases: Use an approved alternative authentication method
Replace a lost or changed authentication device
duo-authentication.access_note: Enrol a supported method before you need it. If all enrolled methods are unavailable, contact IT for recovery

airyorkplus.what_it_is: AirYorkPLUS is York's encrypted wireless network for devices used by current members of the University community
airyorkplus.who_uses_it: Current students and employees with an active Passport York account and a compatible device
use_cases: Connect laptops and phones to secure campus Wi-Fi
Access online academic and work resources
airyorkplus.access_note: Connect to the AirYorkPLUS network using your York credentials and verify network security settings

eduroam.what_it_is: eduroam provides secure Wi-Fi roaming across participating education and research institutions
eduroam.who_uses_it: York students and employees with eligible credentials, and visitors from other participating institutions
use_cases: Connect on campus with a participating institution's account
Use Wi-Fi while visiting other universities
eduroam.access_note: York members authenticate using their institutional eduroam sign-in format, which may differ from their usual email address

airyorkguest.what_it_is: AirYorkGUEST provides temporary wireless access to visitors who cannot use AirYorkPLUS or eduroam
airyorkguest.who_uses_it: Eligible campus visitors and guests, not the primary network for current York members
airyorkguest.access_note: Select AirYorkGUEST and follow the on-screen registration instructions. Guest sessions have limits

residence-internet.what_it_is: Residence wired internet connects supported in-room devices to York's campus network
residence-internet.who_uses_it: Residents in eligible York housing locations with a compatible network-connected device
use_cases: Report an outage affecting a room or residence
residence-internet.access_note: Availability varies by residence. Follow housing network rules and avoid unauthorized networking equipment

york-vpn.what_it_is: York VPN creates a secure remote connection to internal University resources that are not available from the public internet
york-vpn.who_uses_it: Students and employees authorized for systems that require VPN access
use_cases: Access restricted administrative systems from off campus
Connect securely to approved remote resources
york-vpn.access_note: Install the currently supported client and use the VPN configuration authorized for your role. Not every York website requires VPN

google-mail.what_it_is: Google Mail is the centrally supported Gmail mailbox for eligible York undergraduate students
google-mail.who_uses_it: Undergraduate students with an active student email account; employees and graduate students generally use Outlook instead
use_cases: Manage labels, spam and forwarding where permitted
google-mail.access_note: Sign in to your York Google mailbox, not a personal Gmail account

outlook.what_it_is: Outlook is York's Microsoft Exchange Online email and calendar service, with web and desktop clients and delegated mailbox features
outlook.who_uses_it: Faculty, staff and graduate students with a York-hosted Outlook mailbox; undergraduate students generally use Google Mail
use_cases: Open shared mailboxes when granted access
Set automatic replies and delegate permissions
outlook.access_note: Open Outlook directly with your York Microsoft 365 identity. Shared mailboxes require explicit access

listserv.what_it_is: LISTSERV distributes email to managed mailing lists and gives list owners tools to maintain subscribers and posting rules
listserv.who_uses_it: Approved York mailing-list subscribers, moderators and owners
use_cases: Send messages to a mailing list
Review delivery problems and list settings
listserv.access_note: List owners and ordinary subscribers have different permissions. Administrative requests go through the supported list owner or IT

zoom.what_it_is: Zoom supports online video meetings, teaching sessions and webinars using York's institutional service
zoom.who_uses_it: Eligible York employees and other users who are assigned access under York's Zoom arrangements
zoom.access_note: Use York's Zoom sign-in for institutional meeting controls and licensing

microsoft-365-apps.what_it_is: Microsoft 365 is York's suite of online and desktop productivity apps, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
microsoft-365-apps.who_uses_it: Current York students, faculty and staff, with individual app features depending on their assigned licence
use_cases: Install desktop apps when your licence permits
microsoft-365-apps.access_note: Sign in with your York Microsoft 365 account and choose the app you need

microsoft-teams.what_it_is: Microsoft Teams brings workplace chat, video meetings, calls, channels and file collaboration together in one application
microsoft-teams.who_uses_it: Eligible York students and employees, with membership in individual teams controlled by team owners
use_cases: Hold scheduled and ad hoc meetings
Organize files and discussions in channels
microsoft-teams.access_note: Open Teams with your York account. Being eligible for Teams does not automatically add you to a particular team

onedrive.what_it_is: OneDrive is the personal cloud file-storage space associated with an eligible York Microsoft 365 account
onedrive.who_uses_it: Current students and employees with a York OneDrive entitlement
onedrive.access_note: Open your York OneDrive rather than a personal Microsoft storage account. Sharing remains subject to University information rules

sharepoint.what_it_is: SharePoint Online is York's platform for team sites, departmental information and shared document libraries. Unlike OneDrive, content is organized around a team or site rather than an individual's personal file space
sharepoint.who_uses_it: Faculty and staff working in departmental, project or team sites, plus other invited collaborators where a site owner grants permission. Access to a specific site is not automatic
use_cases: Publish and find team information or procedures
Store, organize and co-edit shared documents
Manage access, version history and approved lists
sharepoint.access_note: Sign in to York's SharePoint environment. To open a specific team site, you must have its address or access granted by its owner

microsoft-forms.what_it_is: Microsoft Forms lets eligible Microsoft 365 users build simple online forms, quizzes, surveys and polls
microsoft-forms.who_uses_it: York students and employees with Microsoft Forms available in their institutional account
microsoft-forms.access_note: Use Forms for information approved for this platform; highly sensitive institutional data may require another service

myapps.what_it_is: MyApps is York's portal for running supported academic and workplace applications through remote sessions or web delivery
myapps.who_uses_it: Eligible students, faculty and staff, subject to each application's licence and access rules
use_cases: Launch software without installing it locally
Open a remote app or browser session
Access specialized course or work software
myapps.access_note: Sign in to MyApps and choose the launch option available for your application

software-licences.what_it_is: York's software licensing services distribute approved applications and provide access to institutionally licensed or discounted products
software-licences.who_uses_it: Students and employees where a product licence permits; installation rights vary by affiliation and device ownership
use_cases: Find eligible versions for Windows or Mac
software-licences.access_note: Licences and prices are product-specific. Software for a York-owned computer may require an IT installation request

spss.what_it_is: IBM SPSS Statistics is software for statistical data management, analysis and reporting
spss.who_uses_it: Eligible York students, instructors and researchers with an appropriate software entitlement
spss.access_note: Check York's current SPSS licence and installation route before downloading software

sas.what_it_is: SAS is a statistical and analytical computing platform used for data processing and advanced analysis
sas.who_uses_it: York users in programs or units with an approved SAS entitlement
sas.access_note: Access and supported version depend on your department or program's software arrangements

nvivo.what_it_is: NVivo supports qualitative research by organizing and analysing text, interviews and other research materials
nvivo.who_uses_it: Eligible York researchers, instructors and students with the required licence
nvivo.access_note: Confirm licence eligibility and the current supported version through York's software catalogue

amos.what_it_is: IBM SPSS Amos is a Windows application for structural equation modelling and related statistical analysis
amos.who_uses_it: Eligible York users with Amos licensing, usually for research or advanced coursework
amos.access_note: Check product eligibility and Windows support before installing

eclass.what_it_is: eClass is York's Moodle-based learning management system for courses and academic activities
eclass.who_uses_it: Enrolled students, instructors and designated teaching staff with course access
eclass.access_note: Sign in with Passport York. A course appears when your academic registration and instructor availability permit

turnitin.what_it_is: Turnitin provides text similarity checking and supported assignment workflows integrated with courses
turnitin.who_uses_it: Students and instructors in courses where the instructor has enabled Turnitin
use_cases: Assess submitted documents using instructor tools
turnitin.access_note: Open Turnitin through the assignment inside your course's approved learning environment

iclicker.what_it_is: iClicker is a classroom response tool for quizzes, polls and participation activities chosen by an instructor
iclicker.who_uses_it: Students in courses using iClicker and instructors operating those activities
iclicker.access_note: Follow your course's iClicker registration and participation instructions

lecture-recording.what_it_is: Lecture recording services capture and distribute authorized teaching sessions and course media
lecture-recording.who_uses_it: Instructors using supported recording facilities and students enrolled in courses with published recordings
lecture-recording.access_note: Recording availability and access are controlled by the instructor, room and approved course distribution settings

course-evaluations.what_it_is: Course evaluations give students a structured way to provide feedback on teaching and course experiences
course-evaluations.who_uses_it: Eligible students invited to complete evaluations, and authorized administrators managing the process
course-evaluations.access_note: An evaluation is available only during its scheduled period and for eligible courses

class-lists.what_it_is: Class-list tools provide authorized access to enrolment information for teaching and course administration
class-lists.who_uses_it: Instructors and designated staff with approved access to a particular course
class-lists.access_note: Course access is controlled by academic appointments and student-record permissions

grade-submission.what_it_is: Grade submission systems allow authorized academic staff to submit final course results into University records
grade-submission.who_uses_it: Course instructors and designated academic administrators with grading authorization
grade-submission.access_note: Follow your faculty's current academic records process and published grading deadlines

webprint.what_it_is: WebPrint lets eligible users upload documents through a browser for printing on supported York printers
webprint.who_uses_it: Students and other users with eligibility and sufficient print balance for participating devices
use_cases: Choose a printer and print options
Release and pay for print jobs
webprint.access_note: Sign in through York's WebPrint portal; check the destination printer and account balance before submitting

campus-printers.what_it_is: Public campus print stations provide paid black-and-white or colour output in designated labs and library spaces
campus-printers.who_uses_it: Students and eligible visitors using supported campus print locations
use_cases: Use supported campus print payment methods
campus-printers.access_note: Printer availability, equipment and charges vary by location

managed-printing.what_it_is: Unified Print Management manages print and copy activity on enrolled York departmental devices
managed-printing.who_uses_it: Faculty and staff in units onboarded to managed printing; access is not universal across every department
managed-printing.access_note: Ask local IT whether your unit participates before requesting a printer or print queue

google-drive.what_it_is: Google Drive is a cloud file-storage and collaboration space available through eligible York Google Workspace accounts
google-drive.who_uses_it: Eligible undergraduate students using their York Google account
use_cases: Create and edit Google Docs, Sheets and Slides
google-drive.access_note: Use your institutional Google account and follow its storage and sharing restrictions

fas.what_it_is: File Access Service provides centrally managed shared file storage for approved York teams and administrative processes
fas.who_uses_it: Employees and authorized collaborators with access approved by the file-share owner
use_cases: Store files on departmental shared drives
Support team file workflows with controlled permissions
fas.access_note: A file share and its access permissions must be provisioned or approved; access is not automatic

computer-labs.what_it_is: York computing labs provide shared computers and course-specific software in designated teaching or drop-in spaces
computer-labs.who_uses_it: Students enrolled in courses or faculties with access to the particular lab
computer-labs.access_note: Lab access and hours vary by location, course and faculty

remote-labs.what_it_is: Remote lab access lets eligible York users connect to a supported campus computer or hosted lab session from another location
remote-labs.who_uses_it: Students and employees approved for a specific remote computing lab
use_cases: Use specialized computing resources away from campus
Access a classroom workstation where enabled
remote-labs.access_note: Your faculty must provide the appropriate lab connection method and permission; some labs also require York VPN

workstation-support.what_it_is: Managed workstation support helps with setup, operation and troubleshooting of University-owned laptops and desktops
workstation-support.who_uses_it: York employees whose devices are supported by UIT or their faculty or unit IT team
workstation-support.access_note: Support ownership depends on the device and department; provide asset information with a request

phishing-reporting.what_it_is: York's phishing reporting service receives and investigates suspicious messages that could steal information or compromise accounts
phishing-reporting.who_uses_it: Students and employees receiving messages through University email
use_cases: Request help after a suspected credential exposure
phishing-reporting.access_note: Use the Report Phishing option in your supported mail client when available. Do not interact with suspicious messages first

security-consultation.what_it_is: Information Security consultation supports security risk assessment, advice and response planning for University systems and data
security-consultation.who_uses_it: York employees and technical teams responsible for applications, information or infrastructure
security-consultation.access_note: Consult Information Security before introducing high-risk services or handling restricted institutional information

security-certificates.what_it_is: Digital certificate services support approved certificates that establish trusted encrypted connections for York-managed systems
security-certificates.who_uses_it: Authorized system and application owners and their technical administrators
use_cases: Request a certificate for a managed service
security-certificates.access_note: Certificate requests must identify the authorized service, hostname and technical owner

student-copilot.what_it_is: Microsoft Copilot is an AI assistant available through eligible student Microsoft accounts for general drafting, research support and study tasks
student-copilot.who_uses_it: Current York students with the standard Copilot offering available to their account
student-copilot.access_note: Student Copilot is not the same as licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot or GitHub Copilot. Course rules and data restrictions still apply

employee-copilot.what_it_is: Microsoft Copilot offers AI-assisted drafting, summarization and web-supported productivity through York's approved Microsoft access
employee-copilot.who_uses_it: Faculty and staff with eligible York-supported Copilot access; premium integrations depend on licences
employee-copilot.access_note: Use the York-approved Copilot experience and check data classification before sharing information

m365-copilot.what_it_is: Microsoft 365 Copilot adds licensed AI features within eligible Word, Outlook, Teams and other Microsoft 365 apps
m365-copilot.who_uses_it: Employees assigned the required premium Microsoft 365 Copilot licence
m365-copilot.access_note: This is a separately licensed offering; standard Microsoft Copilot access does not grant the premium features

github-copilot.what_it_is: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant used in approved York development environments
github-copilot.who_uses_it: Eligible faculty and staff assigned a GitHub Copilot licence under York's enterprise arrangement
github-copilot.access_note: Licences and authorized use depend on your GitHub organization. Personal Copilot subscriptions have different data permissions

yu-aura.what_it_is: YU AURA is a York-supported AI assistant for approved institutional tasks and workflows
yu-aura.who_uses_it: Eligible York employees with access approved for the current deployment
use_cases: Ask questions in the authorized AI environment
Explore workflows supported by the tool
yu-aura.access_note: Use the York-provided AURA access channel. Access and permitted information types depend on current institutional settings

hr-self-serve.what_it_is: HR Self-Serve is York's employee portal for personal HR records, payroll documents and applicable benefits and time workflows
hr-self-serve.who_uses_it: Active employees, with functions varying by employment category and role
use_cases: View pay statements and tax slips
Submit applicable time or absence records
hr-self-serve.access_note: Some functions require an active employee account and an approved network connection; off-campus access may require York VPN

halo-itsm.what_it_is: HaloITSM is York's IT service-management system for requesting assistance and managing tickets
halo-itsm.who_uses_it: People eligible to submit support requests, and authorized IT agents handling service work
use_cases: Manage assigned IT workflows if authorized
halo-itsm.access_note: The end-user portal and IT-agent interface have different permissions

maximo.what_it_is: Maximo supports facilities maintenance and work-request processes for approved York operations
maximo.who_uses_it: Authorized York employees and service operators who need the relevant facilities functions
maximo.access_note: Use the York-managed Maximo application and the access route supplied to your unit

sis.what_it_is: The Student Information System supports authorized student-records and academic administration activities
sis.who_uses_it: Employees with role-specific access granted by the responsible academic or administrative unit
sis.access_note: Student records are protected. Access requires explicit authorization and should match work responsibilities

finance-apps.what_it_is: York finance applications support expense, purchasing and other administrative financial workflows
finance-apps.who_uses_it: Employees assigned a role in approved Finance or departmental business processes
finance-apps.access_note: The specific application and permissions depend on business role; use the designated finance system rather than a generic portal

arms.what_it_is: ARMS is an institutionally managed administrative application used in designated York business processes
arms.who_uses_it: Employees authorized by the ARMS business owner; the precise functions depend on assigned permissions
use_cases: Request access changes through the responsible unit
arms.access_note: The legacy catalogue does not adequately explain ARMS's function. Its business purpose and app URL require owner confirmation before publishing detailed claims

wordpress.what_it_is: York's managed WordPress platform hosts official public websites and supported editing tools for departments and academic units
wordpress.who_uses_it: Designated University site owners, editors and other authorized publishing staff
use_cases: Use University themes and approved plugins
wordpress.access_note: A sponsoring unit must own the website and maintain its content. New sites follow the University's approval process

gravity-forms.what_it_is: Gravity Forms is the form builder available within supported York WordPress websites
gravity-forms.who_uses_it: Authorized WordPress editors and form owners with appropriate site permissions
gravity-forms.access_note: Use the York-managed WordPress installation and check data classification before collecting information

machform.what_it_is: MachForm provides a hosted form-building option for approved online data collection that is not part of a WordPress plugin
machform.who_uses_it: York employees whose unit is authorized to use the hosted form platform
machform.access_note: A responsible form owner and approved data collection purpose are required

web-hosting.what_it_is: Application web hosting supports approved department websites and web applications that need infrastructure beyond managed WordPress
web-hosting.who_uses_it: University application owners and technical teams with approved hosting requirements
web-hosting.access_note: Hosting must have a named owner and a viable support model; custom apps are reviewed individually

virtual-servers.what_it_is: Virtual server hosting provides managed computing capacity for approved applications, research and administrative systems
virtual-servers.who_uses_it: Authorized system owners and technical teams requiring server infrastructure
virtual-servers.access_note: Server size, network access, backups and support responsibilities are defined during service intake

server-storage.what_it_is: Server Data Storage provides managed capacity for applications hosted in York's server environments
server-storage.who_uses_it: IT and application teams running authorized institutional workloads
use_cases: Plan data recovery and backup requirements
server-storage.access_note: Choose storage through infrastructure consultation; backup coverage is not assumed for every arrangement

classroom-av.what_it_is: Classroom AV services support podium computers, projectors, microphones, displays and control systems in equipped teaching spaces
classroom-av.who_uses_it: York instructors and authorized staff using supported classrooms
use_cases: Get help when teaching equipment fails
classroom-av.access_note: Support is tied to the specific classroom and installed technology

hyflex.what_it_is: HyFlex classroom technology supports teaching sessions with participants both in a room and online
hyflex.who_uses_it: Instructors assigned to equipped rooms with the appropriate teaching arrangement
use_cases: Share classroom audio and video with remote learners
hyflex.access_note: HyFlex functions are only available in suitably equipped rooms and may require orientation

digital-signage.what_it_is: Digital signage distributes approved news, notices and event information to institutional display screens
digital-signage.who_uses_it: York departments and communications staff authorized to use participating signage networks
digital-signage.access_note: Content, locations and scheduling are subject to the screen network's approval process

tech-library.what_it_is: The technology lending library makes selected AV and computing accessories available for short-term University use
tech-library.who_uses_it: Eligible instructors and employees subject to lending conditions
use_cases: Access temporary webcams or audio devices
Return loan equipment under agreed conditions
tech-library.access_note: Availability, lending periods and required identification depend on the item and lending desk

meeting-room-av.what_it_is: Event and meeting AV services provide supported presentation, sound and recording equipment for University gatherings
meeting-room-av.who_uses_it: York organizers booking approved spaces and technical support
use_cases: Arrange an AV operator for an event
meeting-room-av.access_note: Request support ahead of the event; specialized services may have costs

insight.what_it_is: Insight is York's reporting environment for authorized admissions and enrolment data
insight.who_uses_it: Employees approved by their faculty or unit to view the relevant reporting information
use_cases: Use permitted reports for academic planning
insight.access_note: Access requires approval from the faculty's designated authority

ereports.what_it_is: eReports provides authorized operational reporting across University business information
ereports.who_uses_it: Employees granted report-specific access for their administrative functions
ereports.access_note: Report availability and data freshness vary by source; users receive only approved report access

power-bi.what_it_is: Microsoft Power BI is a reporting and data visualization platform for creating interactive dashboards and analyzing approved datasets
power-bi.who_uses_it: Employees with access to the appropriate Microsoft account, Power BI licence and institutional data
power-bi.access_note: A licence does not by itself grant access to restricted organizational datasets

data-integrations.what_it_is: Data management and integration services connect approved institutional systems and datasets for reporting and business use
data-integrations.who_uses_it: University application owners, analysts and technical staff with a legitimate data-sharing requirement
data-integrations.access_note: Requests require a defined data purpose, source-system approval and security review

computer-purchases.what_it_is: Computer purchasing provides departmental routes for ordering approved laptops, desktop computers and peripherals
computer-purchases.who_uses_it: York employees making authorized work-related technology purchases
computer-purchases.access_note: Current prices and delivery timelines require a fresh quote and departmental purchasing authorization

desk-phones.what_it_is: University desk telephone services provide work extensions and supported calling functions at York locations
desk-phones.who_uses_it: Faculty and staff in departments with phone service and a designated contact
use_cases: Obtain help with hardware or line issues
desk-phones.access_note: New lines and service changes usually require the departmental telephone designate

voicemail.what_it_is: Voicemail and forwarding tools control how supported University telephone extensions receive and route calls
voicemail.who_uses_it: Employees assigned a supported desk-phone extension
use_cases: Forward calls to an approved number
voicemail.access_note: Settings differ by telephone model and extension configuration

mobile-phones.what_it_is: Managed mobile phone services support approved University-issued devices and cellular plans
mobile-phones.who_uses_it: Employees with departmental authorization for institutional mobile service
use_cases: Order or replace a managed phone
Coordinate changes to an existing mobile service
mobile-phones.access_note: Plans, devices and costs follow York's procurement and departmental approval rules

york-github.what_it_is: York GitHub Enterprise provides hosted Git repositories and collaborative software development tools under institutional administration
york-github.who_uses_it: Current York faculty and staff with institutional GitHub access; repositories depend on organization membership
york-github.access_note: Sign in using York's GitHub Enterprise single sign-on. Organization access is granted separately

github-organizations.what_it_is: A GitHub organization groups repositories, teams, access permissions and development policies within York's enterprise
github-organizations.who_uses_it: Approved organization owners and contributors with a legitimate project or team
use_cases: Request GitHub Actions or Copilot access
github-organizations.access_note: A manager or designated owner must sponsor a new organization and configure membership

service-desk.what_it_is: The UIT Service Desk coordinates central IT support requests and directs users to the appropriate technical team
service-desk.who_uses_it: Students, employees and other users supported by University IT
service-desk.access_note: Include the affected service, error, device and location; never include passwords or verification codes
